 Home » Payments » NETS to End CashCard Use for Parking, Tolls on 1 January 2027 Payments NETS to End CashCard Use for Parking, Tolls on 1 January 2027
 The NETS Customer Service Centre will be the only place to request a refund from 1 April 2027. Fintech News Singapore November 17, 2026 2 Mins Read LinkedIn Facebook Twitter Telegram Copy Link Email Share LinkedIn Facebook Twitter Copy Link Telegram Email Free Newsletter Get the hottest Fintech Singapore News once a month in your Inbox
 NETS will retire its CashCard on 1 January 2027, ending its use for road charges and retail purchases in Singapore.
 The phase-out follows Singapore’s shift to Electronic Road Pricing (ERP) 2, a satellite-based system for collecting road charges.
 NETS advised motorists who use the CashCard for ERP charges, car park fees or checkpoint tolls to switch to a NETS Motoring Card or NETS FlashPay Card by 31 December 2026.
 Cardholders can request refunds at DBS/POSB, OCBC and UOB branches until 31 March 2027.
 OCBC and UOB account holders can also use OCBC or UOB ATMs until that date.
 The deadline for refunds at DBS/POSB ATMs was 15 November 2026.
 Only the NETS Customer Service Centre will handle refund requests from 1 April 2027.
 Cardholders have up to four years from their card’s expiry date to claim any remaining balance.
 NETS refunds the full balance if they apply within two years of expiry.
 A S$1 monthly fee applies once those two years are up and stops when NETS processes the refund, the balance runs out or the four-year period ends, whichever comes first.
